environment: local disposable PGlite; no Neon connection or mutation

scalingComparison.method: Same in-memory database, schema and service functions; independent RT fixtures at 50 and 500 households. One unrecorded warmup then three timed runs per service path and fixture; ratios use the median of three.
scalingComparison.queryCount: not instrumented; Drizzle/PGlite wrapper does not expose a reliable count without changing query execution
scalingComparison.perHouseholdQueryPattern: No obvious service-level per-household read loop in inspected report/list implementations; each fetch uses batched queries. Source inspection only.
scalingComparison.interpretation: Compare warmed median ratios to the 10x dataset multiplier. Shared-process cache effects remain possible; this is PGlite, not Neon, and establishes no production SLA.

paymentFixtureAssessment: 50/500 valid resident requests, half verified using existing services. Queue, allocations, payments and audit constraints exercised. Rejection/reversal are covered by regression tests, not timed here.

memory.note: single end-of-run sample; no profiler/peak sampling
